name: Pensieve
description:
Pensieve builds a context layer for your company.

It connects to the tools your work already lives in, including Slack, Notion, Google Drive, GitHub, HubSpot, Attio and Linear, and continuously curates what it finds into a navigable map of Pages: what your product does, who your customers are, what was decided and why.

This connector gives Claude access to that map. Instead of searching each tool separately and stitching the results together, Claude reads a layer that has already been curated across all of them. Every answer cites the source documents it came from, so you can check the working.

Claude can also write back. It can capture a decision from a conversation, correct a Page that has gone stale, or add structure as your company changes.

Pensieve keeps the layer current on its own. When a document changes in a connected tool, the affected Pages are revisited, so what Claude reads reflects the company as it is now rather than as it was when it was first connected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pensieve to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pensieve to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pensieve.uk/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pensieve MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pensieve lists 16 MCP tools, including create_page, delete_page, edit_page, get_tree, list_contexts, list_trees, merge_pages, move_page, query_table, read, read_change, and save_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pensieve?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pensieve in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Pensieve requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pensieve is developed by Pensieve. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
